values: Google style fixes one naming form for each kind of name, so a name reads the same everywhere; the formatter does not rename.
Treat abbreviations as words: no run of capitals, so parseUrl, HttpClient, userId, never parseURL, HTTPClient or userID.
Google style fixes one layout. A layout finding means the file is not formatted, and the project's formatter is the allowed form.

Run the formatter of the project (`google-java-format`, `google-java-format --aosp`, `palantir-java-format`) on the file; with no formatter, fix the layout by hand. Not your formatter: pin "conventions.java.formatter" to "google", "palantir" or "none" in nitpicker.config.json.
